scope: Public image metadata for actual normal-play Android emulator captures. Private capture/log/save/process evidence is omitted. All packaged frames remain1080x1920; tablet names denote logical overrides on the same emulator, not physical tablet tests.
source_identity_summary: Selected source and installed APK identities matched during local verification. Original raw and approved portrait PNG bytes are preserved; only the documented90-degree orientation correction differs. No resize, crop, overlays, framing or fabricated content.

captures.game_state: Normal offline home view reached through real navigation and played progress; no fixture or diagnostic launch arguments.
captures.orientation_correction: 90 degrees clockwise to Android display orientation; no crop/content changes
captures.pixel_processing: Byte-for-byte copy of the approved portrait PNG and original raw framebuffer PNG; no resizing, crop, overlays, framing, or fabricated content.
captures.visual_review: Actual frame inspected by AI operator for readable normal content and unobstructed controls. Human acceptance remains unverified.
